::: {.intro}
<div>

I am the Ervin K. Zingler Chair of Economics at Rice University, where I chair the
Department of Economics and direct the Center for Economic Mobility at the Kinder
Institute for Urban Research.

I work on labor economics, and specifically on how human capital is formed over the
life cycle: what parents believe about their children's development, how those
beliefs shape investment, and what early interventions actually change. My work has
been recognized with the Frisch Medal from the Econometric Society and the Aigner
Award from the *Journal of Econometrics*.

</div>
:::
